title: Google My Business: A guide to Google Business Profile
summary: Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business) is a free business listing that supports reviews, Q&As, posts, and more.
body_markdown:
## Check your Google Business Profile for issues


Check your Google Business Profile for issues after setting it up or claiming it. A quick review now catches


gaps and problems before they hurt your rankings.


The free GBP Optimizer is the fastest way to review your profile and make sure nothing is missing.


### Download your free GBP Optimizer


Use your GBP Optimizer inside your favorite AI assistant like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any coding agent of choice.


The tool will ask you some questions about your profile and then grade it. You’ll get a prioritized checklist of action items so you don’t waste time on tasks that won’t improve visibility.


### How to use your GBP Optimizer


**For use in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot:** Download the lite-prompt.md file and upload it into your AI assistant.


Answer the prompts so the tool has the information it needs for analysis.


**For use in Claude Code or Codex:** Download the .zip file, open it, and add the new folder to your AI assistant.


Then enter “Run the GBP Optimizer.”


Go through the prompts so your tool has the right information to analyze.


Newer models sometimes check in with a question or permission request first. Respond, and it continues automatically.


Both methods will analyze your GBP, grade your profile, and provide a list of action items.
